title: Quentin and the Contact
author: Felix Sandoval
blurb: Odile Crane, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
